info.title: OMA LwM2M ECID-Signal Measurement Information (Object ID 10256)

ECID-Signal_Measurement_Information.label: ECID-Signal Measurement Information
ECID-Signal_Measurement_Information.description: This LWM2M Object provides ECID signal measurements of a device.

physCellId.label: physCellId
physCellId.description: This field specifies the physical cell identity of the measured cell.

ECGI.label: ECGI
ECGI.description: This field specifies cell global ID of the measured cell. The target device shall provide this field if it was able to determine the ECGI of the measured cell at the time of measurement.

arfcnEUTRA.label: arfcnEUTRA
arfcnEUTRA.description: This field specifies the ARFCN of the measured E-UTRA carrier frequency.

rsrp-Result_.label: rsrp-Result
rsrp-Result_.description: This field specifies the reference signal received power (RSRP) measurement.

rsrq-Result.label: rsrq-Result
rsrq-Result.description: This field specifies the reference signal received quality (RSRQ) measurement.

ue-RxTxTimeDiff.label: ue-RxTxTimeDiff
ue-RxTxTimeDiff.description: This field specifies the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement.
